description: Retrieve one How to pay catalog entry by its id, e.g. stripe, x402. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use rail_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the How to pay catalog, e.g. stripe, x402. Get the id list from rail_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: rail_get
